batch_cap_nodes.description: Maximum nodes one rolling batch may include under the error-budget batch cap.

budget_remaining_minutes.description: Budget minutes remaining (budget minus charged) that decide whether the batch cap applies.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

dr_lane_nodes.description: Affected nodes on the DR lane that patch through LANE-DR sessions, not Saturday's edge session.

drain_minutes_per_node.description: Per-node drain, restart, and rejoin minutes from the current DRAIN-MIN metering.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: edge-lane nodes pinned for the fraud-model canary

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Quillstone's confirmed standard and early-access dates for the hardened DR image.

first_batch_window.description: Lane and session of the first batch, as LANE/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

lane_nodes_active.description: Active checkout-web nodes on the edge lane, the base of the batch cap.

nodes_on_fixed_version.description: Nodes already on the fixed runtime version (the canary pair) and outside the requirement.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for the checkout-web rolling patch batches.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: NODE.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing batch_within_cap_then_dr_standard, expedite_hardened_dr_image, unpin_canary_nodes_with_board_exception.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

source_quantity.description: checkout-web nodes still on an affected runtime version that QSA-2026-121 must reach

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Quillstone's confirmed standard and early-access dates for the hardened DR image.

supported_quantity.description: affected checkout-web nodes on the edge lane that Saturday's batch may include

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.

window_capacity_nodes.description: Nodes one 4-hour session can drain at the current per-node timing.

facts.rubric: Applied the effective change, advisory, and policy to establish 16 NODE for checkout-web nodes still on an affected runtime version that QSA-2026-121 must reach, with control date 2026-04-29.

facts.rubric: Reconciled 14 observed less 2 excluded to 12 supported NODE for affected checkout-web nodes on the edge lane that Saturday's batch may include.
facts.statement: of the 14 edge-lane nodes, 2 are pinned for the fraud-model canary until 2026-04-21, so 12 may be batched; the budget cap (19 of 43 remaining) limits one batch to 8 and the session drains 12 at 20 minutes per node; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a headline total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-04-17 early-access readiness input for expedite_hardened_dr_image, then separately derived its 2026-04-25 operating outcome under the error-budget batch cap and the window drain capacity instead of treating a vendor date as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Quillstone's confirmed standard and early-access dates for the hardened DR image: Quillstone confirms the hardened DR image 2026-04-22 standard (eligible 2026-04-23) or 2026-04-16 early access (eligible 2026-04-17, +USD 600); a vendor release date alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied the booked LANE-EDGE session and the LANE-DR weekend sessions to derive the three option outcomes without using protected, frozen, blocked, or uncovered sessions.
facts.statement: the booked LANE-EDGE session and the LANE-DR weekend sessions: CHG-40320 holds LANE-EDGE 2026-04-18 NIGHT; the DR pair patches in LANE-DR's weekend sessions, 2026-04-18 with the expedited image or 2026-04-25 with the standard one; protected, frozen, and uncovered sessions cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-SO-0102 only to batch_within_cap_then_dr_standard and CHG-40320; kept unpin_canary_nodes_with_board_exception outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-SO-0102 covers batches within the cap on LANE-EDGE with no fees; unpinning the canary nodes needs the risk lead and the change board chair. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize unpin_canary_nodes_with_board_exception.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected batch_within_cap_then_dr_standard: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies the error-budget batch cap and the window drain capacity.
facts.statement: the fleet must complete before the 2026-04-29 SLA with the implementers told exactly which nodes Saturday covers; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside the error-budget batch cap and the window drain capacity.

options.consequence: batch within cap then DR standard patches 8 nodes on Saturday 2026-04-18 and the remaining 4 unpinned lane nodes on Sunday, takes the 2 canary-pinned nodes after the pin ends on 2026-04-21, and patches the 2 DR nodes on the standard hardened image in the LANE-DR session of 2026-04-25, four days inside the SLA at no incremental cost.
options.label: batch_within_cap_then_dr_standard: outcome 2026-04-25, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: expedite hardened DR image would have the DR variant production-eligible on 2026-04-17 for USD 600 and patch the DR nodes on 2026-04-18, but the two canary-pinned nodes still wait for the 2026-04-21 pin end and the next LANE-EDGE weekend, so the fleet still completes 2026-04-25.
options.label: expedite_hardened_dr_image: outcome 2026-04-25, incremental cost USD 600, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: unpin canary nodes with board exception would patch the pinned nodes on Sunday 2026-04-19 alongside the expedited DR image, six days earlier, for USD 600, but unpinning the fraud-model canary needs the risk lead and the change board chair and the fee needs the security lead; AP-SO-0102 carries neither.
options.label: unpin_canary_nodes_with_board_exception: outcome 2026-04-19, incremental cost USD 600, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
